sources.excerpt: STANDARD MACHINE STANDARD MACHINE The Standard Machine is a sonic replica of the Ibanez Standard Fuzz. It is very close in tone (and electrically) to the classic Shin-ei built Superfuzz, but with more of everything. More fuzz, more volume, more extreme! Super fat and compressed octave fuzz tone which nail those 60’s, 70’s tones and beyond in a small package. Fitted with a carefully selected set of vintage correct, matched 2SC828 transistors and a 2SK30A FET at the front end to drive the fuzzy, octave madness.
